calculators.name: Free RC Beam Designer
calculators.desc: Perform free advanced reinforced concrete beam flexural design per ACI 318 & BNBC 2020. Supports Singly, Doubly, and T-Beam sections with live SVG scaling, stress block visualizations, and calculation breakdowns.

calculators.name: Free RC Column Designer
calculators.desc: Calculate rectangular tied or circular spiral column capacity under axial loads and moments per ACI 318 code. Features live interaction diagrams and rebar layout drawings.

calculators.name: Free RC Slab Designer
calculators.desc: One-way and two-way slab thickness checks and reinforcement distribution per ACI 318 minimum thickness coefficients.

calculators.name: Free Square Footing Designer
calculators.desc: Isolated square footing sizing, bearing pressure checks, punching and one-way shear, and rebar detailing.

calculators.name: Free Rectangular Footing Designer
calculators.desc: Rectangular isolated footing design with biaxial moment handling, bearing checks, and reinforcement schedules.
